name: One person holding multiple identities or accounts
description: The same individual appears under different names or opens several accounts or wallets, directly or through an intermediary.
fp: Customers may legitimately hold several products or use name variants; look for deliberate inconsistency.

links.name: Use of multiple payment apps and e-wallets with different names
links.ctx: Same user holds several e-wallets under various identities, funded with cash vouchers.

links.name: Use of multiple identities or accounts
links.ctx: Same person plays under different names or accounts.

links.name: Multiple accounts opened for same individual or by same agent
links.ctx: One person or intermediary opens accounts at several institutions or products.
